copy.title: Karanda Interiors — Interior Design, Sutherland Shire & Sydney
copy.description: Interior design for homes and businesses across Sydney's south. Residential, commercial and hospitality interiors, renovations, new builds and floor plan redesign, led by Toni Ford F.D.I.A. 5.0 from 15 Google reviews.
copy.headline:
Forty years of
getting it
right.
copy.sub: Toni Ford has over 40 years' experience in the design industry and holds a Fellowship of the Design Institute of Australia. She works your project personally, from the first floor plan to the last cushion — not handed to a junior halfway through.
copy.heroSecondarySms: Or text a photo of the space
copy.statementBody: A lot of design studios hand your project to whoever is free that week. At Karanda, Toni's own training in interior architecture and construction resolves the complex floor plan issues herself, and her name is the one clients mention, unprompted, in review after review.
copy.servicesIntro: Renovations, new builds and floor plan redesign. Furniture, lighting, blinds, shutters and custom upholstery from our in-house fabric library. Commercial and hospitality interiors, including joint projects with The Company of Fire.
copy.apertureLine: We work with you from the blueprint. No legwork, no chasing suppliers.
copy.workIntro: Real projects from Cronulla, Sylvania, Caringbah, Double Bay and beyond — kitchens, living spaces and full homes, designed and styled by Karanda.
copy.processIntro: From the first look at your space to a tailored plan of action, before anything is booked in.
copy.reviewsIntro: Real reviews from their Google profile: 5.0 from 15 reviews. Toni is named personally in almost every one.
copy.recognitionHeadline: A Fellow of the Design Institute of Australia.
copy.recognitionIntro: Toni's credentials and industry standing, alongside the trade partners and platforms that know her work.
copy.areasIntro: Based in Sylvania Heights. These are the suburbs where we've completed projects — not a strict boundary, so if you're further out, just ask.

faq.a: Face-to-face consultations, drafting and sourcing work are charged at $300 (inc. GST) an hour with a senior designer, or $150 (inc. GST) an hour with a junior designer. Commercial packages are available after an initial consultation. All pricing quoted is RRP.

faq.q: Do you handle new builds, or only renovations?
faq.a: Both. New Builds and Renovations and Developments are both on our services list, alongside Floor Plan Redesign for existing homes that just need the layout fixed.

faq.q: Will I have to source materials and suppliers myself?
faq.a: No. We're a one-stop solution studio — there's no legwork for you to do. We work with you right from the blueprint phase, and our strength is in offering materials that aren't visible on the market elsewhere.

faq.q: Do you only do homes, or commercial work too?
faq.a: Both. Commercial and Hospitality Interior Design are on our services list, and we've worked on multi-residential common areas too — David Murray's review describes us designing the refurbishment of his apartment complex's foyer in Miranda.

faq.q: Can you help with just furniture, blinds or upholstery — not a full renovation?
faq.a: Yes. Furniture curation, our Blinds & Shutter Studio, custom upholstery and our in-house fabric library are each their own service, separate from a full interior design project.
